reason: The submitted CIF is valid and primitive: it symmetry-expands in P2 (No. 3) to 14 fully occupied, explicitly ordered atoms with BaCu6Te6S, Z=1, and the stated 7.0224 x 6.9588 x 6.9305 A, beta=90.764 degree cell. Indexing is exceptionally strong (M20=114.3, F20=168.7, zero unindexed among the first 20), and the trace maps 70 observed lines through 63 degrees with 0.007 degree RMS; direct verification also finds the important 63-90 degree reflections at the calculated positions. Atomic coordinates were instantiated and whole-profile tested: the ordered model's weighted profile residual is 0.02931 after P2 coordinate refinement, its extracted/calculated intensities agree closely, all 28 parent Cu-vacancy orderings were compared, and the next inequivalent ordering is materially worse (0.05503 versus 0.03651 before final refinement). The tied best vacancy pair is related by axis reversal rather than a distinct framework, while alternative S placements strongly fail the intensities. The primitive structure has no overlap (minimum distance 2.265 A), complete shells give plausible Cu-S, Cu-Te, Cu-Cu, and Te-Te contacts, and Ba2+/Cu+/Te-/S2- is charge balanced. Thus one explicit ordered realization has convergent positional and intensity support, and no concrete diffraction-compatible ordering, symmetry, superstructure, or framework branch remains.
